about: Independent test of tools/mapbuild/search_ref.py against out/places.db, written by the tester, not by the search's builder. Every expectation was decided from a plain scan of table p (regex over fold(name)+' | '+fold(alt), category keys, kinds, distance) and knowledge of the area, before any of these queries went through the search. A result counts as a hit when it satisfies expect. name_re is matched on the folded text (أإآ to ا, ة to ه, ى to ي, ؤ to و, ئ to ي, ء removed, marks removed, lower case). name_or_cat: either one is enough; otherwise all given conditions must hold. within_km is from near: 1.5 x the nearest right row in the data + 3 km, at least 3 km, and for a place or kind of place at most 120 km (past that the data has no useful answer for that driver: such a case has truth_rows_in_bar 0 and counts as a data gap). place is [lat, lon, km]: the right row must be there, wherever the car is. truth_rows: rows in p that satisfy expect without within_km. truth_nearest_km: the nearest of them. amended: this expectation was changed after the first run, and why; git has the first version (8aaa4b0).
